messages.subject: User defined sampler
parts:
Hi,

Although I attend the nimble virtual workshop in June of the last year, I have recently started using it. I am trying to use my own MCMC sampler. As a simple exercise, I am implementing a linear regression model. I am using the conjugate prior for the betas, but instead of using the default cojuage_dnorm_dnorm sampler, I want to use the analytically derived full conditionals.

I found that the beta0 and sigma are challenging to recover. I attached a document and R code files for details of my try. Could you suggest me to get a solution to it?

Regards
Paritosh

messages.author: 63cc02caac0434cf
messages.subject: Re: User defined sampler
parts:
Hi Paritosh,

It should be " M <- V*(sum(e)/(sigma*sigma) + m0/(s0*s0))" in the beta0 sampler. You made a typo and had " M <- V*(sum(e)/(s0*s0) + m0/(s0*s0))".
